literal_meaning: টেনে টুনে (টেনে হিঁচড়ে বা টানাহ্যাঁচড়া করে)
figurative_meaning_en: with great difficulty; somehow or barely managing
similar_in_english: by the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় উত্তীর্ণ হওয়ার জন্য সে টেনেটুনে পড়াশোনা করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are running their household with great difficulty.
He barely managed to pass the exam by studying against all odds.
note: This idiom evokes images of laborious pulling, common in agrarian Bengali contexts.
